entries.title: Save follow-up work through MCP
entries.description: Create, inspect and cancel saved follow-up requests for a specific project and review. Requests appear in the existing waiting list, keep their identity across retries and restarts, and wait for an explicit Run action before starting. Cancelling a queued request leaves ongoing work running.

entries.title: Start concurrent local jobs without false CLI errors
entries.description: Overlapping checks wait for the current Codex version probe before validating their own result. A healthy check no longer makes another project report that the CLI is unavailable. Each check keeps its original time limit and cancellation scope.

entries.title: Read English guides and clearer release notes
entries.description: Repository guides and release notes use English. Release notes group visible feature changes before installation, verification and source details. GitHub issue discussions remain in Korean.

entries.title: Find Codex CLI automatically on macOS
entries.description: Detect the CLI bundled with Codex or ChatGPT and show its version and path in Accounts. Use the same selected executable for default local projects, keep valid manual choices, and retry failed checks. Copy troubleshooting details with personal paths hidden.

entries.title: Run project QA in separate windows
entries.description: Use project-scoped QA sessions to work on multiple projects while keeping their windows and review context separate.

entries.title: Discover review categories through MCP
entries.description: Find category IDs through the public MCP API before creating or updating reviews.

entries.title: Capture existing web sessions in Home reviews
entries.description: Attach captures from an already open project web source while preserving its current page and unsaved form state.

entries.title: Track development versions and their history
entries.description: Show development numbers within each base version and retain source-bound update history alongside compatible installer names.

entries.title: Recover capture sessions after a renderer failure
entries.description: Restore the owned capture session after a renderer crash or UI reload while retaining project scope.

entries.title: Keep web previews reliable after reload
entries.description: Reload a project without leaving stale web views behind or interrupting newer previews and other projects.
